## Analysis

`sol_0006` directly tested the prior recommendation—8–24 independently mutable boundary rows—and exactly reproduced `sol_0005`. This refutes deeper endcap optimization as the next source of improvement. Across `sol_0003–6`, gains came from repeated row structure, while increasing size and boundary freedom quickly saturated. The homogeneous central mask is now the likely bottleneck: it restricts mesoscopic sum collisions to a single row type. The next search should introduce a periodic multi-mask core, allowing complementary row types throughout the construction rather than only near its ends.
